title: Inspect principal axes of noisy linear data
description: You compare component variance with centered points and projected histograms.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create x values and add Gaussian noise to y=2x. The scratch PCA call returns two component directions and projected coordinates.
You print the mean and variance information, then center the data. Each drawn axis scales its component direction by the supplied factor times the square root of its eigenvalue.

steps.question: Which component contains most of the recorded variance?
steps.answer: PC1 contains most of the variance. PC2 contains the smaller share, with its eigenvalue reported in the output.

steps.description: You display the centered points with component axes and separate histograms of Z2's columns. Each histogram shows coordinates along one principal component.
